pages.text: Worn on your head or held in hand.

**Flora:** look at an elemental flora to read its essence, or at an [[apothecary_altar]] to see every flora in its reach, element by element.

**Buoys:** see the links between [[buoys]] within 48 blocks: **yellow** for a complete loop, **red** for a course with an end. Worn, they tint your view rose.

**Cells:** a mob in a [[cell_upgrade|cell]] is labelled with its name, as a name tag would show it.

**RC boats:** right-click a motorboat with the [[rc_upgrade]] on a course to start or stop it.
